user.title: S2000-PP via S2000-Ethernet
user.description: IP and UDP port of the S2000-Ethernet converter, zones to poll and exchange parameters.

data_description.poll_interval: Minimum 1 s. A cycle over N zones takes about N/group x 0.08 s – keep the period well above that.
data_description.stale_timeout: A zone not updated for longer than this becomes unavailable. Must be GREATER than the poll period (>= 3x recommended).
data_description.group_size: Adjacent zones are read in one request. 8 is safe; larger is faster with 512 zones – verify with bench_c2000pp.py.
data_description.use_events: Fast updates and bolid_event events on the HA bus. Reading the journal is DESTRUCTIVE: enable in one place only (see readme).
data_description.allow_control: Creates (disabled by default) 'Zone N arming' switches.

error.stale_le_poll: Staleness timeout must be greater than the poll period
